description_en: Restarts one or more instances in an application
description_zh: 调用RestartInstances接口重启应用实例
name: RestartInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to be restarted. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要重启的实例ID。多个实例时使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Take note of the following rules:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change order

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned if the request failed. Take note of the following rules:

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request succeeds.

If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the "Error codes" section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information that is returned. Take note of the following rules:

success: If the call is successful, success is returned.

An error code: If the call fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the instances are successfully restarted. Take note of the following rules:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
重启应用实例是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：重启成功。
false：重启失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
